title: Every incident read takes over a second because a no-op sweep reloads and deep-copies the whole store

summary.cause: Incident read routes (GET /api/incidents, GET /api/incidents/{incident_id}, GET /api/incidents/{incident_id}/operator-payload) invoked resolve_stale_monitor_agent_findings (@_serialized_store_write) unconditionally. Even when zero records needed resolution, @_serialized_store_write entered _write_guard (acquiring flock and unconditionally clearing and reloading the entire 16.5MB JSON store) and performed whole-store deepcopy of _incidents and _postmortems while holding _thread_lock.
summary.fix: Added read-only predicates under @_serialized_store_read (IncidentStore.has_stale_monitor_agent_findings and IncidentStore.has_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents) that share single candidate-selection helpers (_stale_monitor_agent_finding_candidates and _orphaned_infrastructure_incident_candidates) with the write methods. Updated resolve_stale_agent_finding_incidents and reconcile_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents in services/incidents/main.py to check the read-only predicate first and proceed only when work exists, while keeping the original per-incident outbox-prepare -> update_incident_status(expected_snapshot=...) -> outbox-activate loop in reconcile_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents so a prepare failure leaves the incident open. Preserved the unconditional reload in _write_guard and rollback deepcopy in _serialized_store_write unchanged, and re-evaluated candidates inside _write_guard on the write path.

ac2_noop_reconcile_infrastructure_health.details: reconcile_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents checks has_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents first (0 write_guard / 0 _load / 0 deepcopy on no-op) and keeps the original per-incident find_open_incidents -> _prepare_postmortem_delivery -> update_incident_status(expected_snapshot=...) -> outbox_store.activate loop so a prepare failure leaves the incident open.

ac3_stale_finding_resolved_once_before_r.details: First GET resolves the stale finding once (write_guard=1, save=1) before constructing the response so the response omits the resolved finding from open_only=true; subsequent GET performs 0 _load and 0 deepcopy calls.

subcases_verified: Finding re-observed by another process between has_stale_monitor_agent_findings() and _write_guard reload remains open with fresh observation evidence preserved
Finding already closed by another process between has_stale_monitor_agent_findings() and _write_guard reload keeps its concurrent closed status and resolution_reason
Orphaned infrastructure incident already resolved by another process between has_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents() and find_open_incidents() keeps its concurrent resolution_reason

Orphaned infrastructure incident resolved by another process after find_open_incidents() / outbox prepare is caught by expected_snapshot CAS inside _write_guard and keeps its concurrent resolution_reason

ac5_cross_process_mtime_refresh_sees_sta.details: Two IncidentStore instances sharing one JSON file confirm that a stale monitor-agent finding written by the second instance updates file mtime/size, is loaded by _refresh_from_disk inside has_stale_monitor_agent_findings on the first instance, and is resolved before the GET response is returned.

postgres_owner_table_reads_per_get.explanation: PostgresIncidentStore._refresh_from_disk() executes 2 owner table reads per store operation: 1 SELECT on incident.incident_cases (_incident_records.list_all) and 1 SELECT on incident.postmortems (_postmortem_records.list_all). On a no-op GET, replacing the unconditional @_serialized_store_write call (resolve_stale_monitor_agent_findings) with the @_serialized_store_read predicate (has_stale_monitor_agent_findings) preserves the exact same number of owner table reads per GET while eliminating 2 whole-store deepcopy calls per GET.

ac8_contract_and_test_preservation.justification: No existing test assertions were modified, weakened, or removed. Only additive predicate assertions in services/incident/test_incident.py and the new regression/benchmark suite in services/incidents/test_read_sweep_cost.py were added.
